title: A room for Chinese craft
alt: A blue-and-white porcelain tiger rests below a circular red lacquer dragon panel.
description: Ceramic and lacquer references arranged as one coherent museum display, preserving their distinctive forms.

frames.label: Input 1
frames.alt: A reclining white porcelain tiger is decorated with fine cobalt-blue ornament.
frames.prompt: An exquisite museum photograph of an elegant reclining tiger sculpture made from glossy ivory porcelain, decorated with intricate cobalt-blue floral patterns that follow its anatomy and curved body. One clearly connected head, natural ears and facial features, coherent folded legs and a single curving tail attached at the rear. The floral painting bends over the ceramic surfaces and catches tiny specular highlights. Dark blue lacquer display plinth, warm gray plaster background and soft directional light. Sophisticated Chinese contemporary craft, crisp glaze, fine hand-painted details, no lettering.

frames.label: Input 2
frames.alt: A sculpted dragon has glossy lacquer scales and precise gold decoration.
frames.prompt: A magnificent close photograph of a Chinese lacquer art panel depicting one elegant dragon flowing through clouds. The dragon has one unmistakable head, a continuous sinuous body and one tapering tail; its claws emerge naturally from the visible body while other parts disappear behind layered clouds. Deep cinnabar-red carved lacquer, fine black-and-gold inlay, delicate individual scales and whiskers, and precise relief-carved cloud edges create extraordinary tactile depth. The panel is presented on a dark neutral background with controlled raking light that reveals its craftsmanship. No duplicated heads, detached limbs or floating ornaments, no lettering.

frames.label: Result
frames.alt: A blue-and-white porcelain tiger rests below a circular red lacquer dragon panel.
frames.prompt: Photograph a refined museum display containing exactly the two artworks in the reference images. The blue-and-white porcelain tiger from image 1 rests on a low indigo plinth in the foreground, preserving its reclining pose, single tail and floral decoration. The red circular lacquer dragon panel from image 2 hangs centrally on the warm-gray wall behind it, preserving its one dragon, cloud carving, gold details and circular shape. Keep both complete artworks unobstructed and distinct. Controlled gallery spotlights, exquisite ceramic and lacquer material detail, deep elegant shadows, no visitors, labels or extra artworks.
